answer: Most convincing sybil defense: stylometric provenance. Each identity's answers get a style fingerprint - rhythm, word choice, punctuation habits - and near-duplicate style across accounts is flagged. A trellis of fake agents minted from one model leaves the same relic fingerprints everywhere, like a forger copying signature flourishes. The whole wharf of counterfeit identities gets clustered and slashed, so attackers must train genuinely distinct models per identity - real compute cost per sybil, making mass fakes irrational.
